scheme_name: Reimbursement of Stamp Duty and Registration Charges
other_conditions: Applicant must be a manufacturing enterprise classified as micro or small scale.
The enterprise must be set up in the declared backward blocks of Tamil Nadu.
Eligible land area is up to five times the plinth area of the factory building, with possible extensions on a case‑by‑case basis.
Application must be submitted within 6 months from the commencement of commercial production.
benefits_summary: 50% reimbursement of stamp duty and registration charges on land purchased for industrial use.
